decisions.reason: The wind-noise clause independently establishes the audio-cleanup Requirement and is already represented by same-message Events; the caption-shadow change does not further alter its state.
Removing a caption shadow and wind noise does not change background-music selection or mixing requirements.
The source does not change how B-roll must be selected or integrated.
The black-shadow instruction is a caption-specific presentation rule already owned by the source Requirement, not a change to the broader clean-editing or transition policy.
Message 260 does not alter clip-duration limits; the duration instruction appears only in the later message 261.
Caption styling within edited video clips does not change the dedicated Instagram account's setup or audience-routing state.
The review feedback does not change the completed initial three-clip trial's count, source content, or acceptance condition.
The source discusses caption shadow and wind-noise cleanup, not source-video or moment selection.
Message 260 does not change lesson completeness or standalone comprehension; the relevant completeness instruction appears in message 261.
The source does not add, remove, or otherwise alter any target publishing channel.
Identifying clips 3 and 5 as strongest does not necessarily modify the effective-hook requirement.
The source concerns on-video caption styling, not Instagram post caption text, hashtags, or account tagging, and it does not resolve the handle ambiguity.
